title: Mae Aniseya
description: Left for dead by Master Sol and the Jedi on Brendok, Mæ Aniseya took an altogether darker path. Trained by the Sith, she vowed revenge for the murder of her mothers and worked to hunt down the four Jedi responsible: Indara, Sol, Kelnacca, and Torbin. However, when she discovered that her sister, Osha, was still alive and that her understanding of the truth wasn't complete, her world changed entirely.
